facts.value: Grounded and aerial entry clear the command variables before motion and animation initialization and install the hurtbox detector; detection transitions require cmd_vars[0] != 0 and an eligible fighter or item while a startup motion is active. Grounded startup has separate generic-collision, ground-loss, and enabled wall-cancellation branches; connected ground loss uses hit rather than miss recovery. Aerial startup applies move-local gravity only on ticks where cmd_vars[1] == 1, while the connected aerial state applies it unconditionally. Aerial completion selects ordinary Fall for zero configured hit/miss lag and special fall otherwise; aerial landing forwards the corresponding lag to LandingFallSpecial.
facts.rationale: Corrects the baseline assertion that startup begins with detection enabled. Installing the callback does not bypass its nonzero command gate. The explicit reset precedes delegated animation initialization, so the post-initialization command value and script activation timing are not inferred. Preserves distinct collision guards, per-tick gravity gating, and hit/miss recovery branches.

evidence.why: Command resets, ordered motion/animation initialization, callback installation, and aerial gravity reset.
Nonzero detection gate, exact object eligibility, and startup-only dispatch.
Hit/miss completion and distinct startup/connected gravity guards.
Generic collision, ground loss, wall cancellation, and hit/miss landing outcomes.
